description: This source file implements the TpmKeymasterEnforcement class, which provides security enforcement functionalities for TPM-based key management, including token validation, HMAC computation, and key ID creation within the Android Open Source Project's secure environment.

classes.name: CompareHmacSharingParams
classes.description: A comparator class for HmacSharingParameters used in sorting and set operations.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Comparison operator for HmacSharingParameters used in sorting.

methods.name: timespec_to_ms
methods.description: Converts a timespec structure to milliseconds.

methods.name: get_wall_clock_time_ms
methods.description: Retrieves the current wall clock time in milliseconds.

methods.name: activation_date_valid
methods.description: Checks if the activation date is valid (not in the future).

methods.name: expiration_date_passed
methods.description: Checks if the expiration date has passed.

methods.name: auth_token_timed_out
methods.description: Determines if an auth token has timed out based on its timestamp and a timeout value.

methods.name: get_current_time_ms
methods.description: Gets the current system time in milliseconds.

methods.name: SecurityLevel
methods.description: Returns the security level of the enforcement (trusted environment).

methods.name: ValidateTokenSignature
methods.description: Validates the signature of an auth token using gatekeeper's key.

methods.name: GetHmacSharingParameters
methods.description: Generates or retrieves saved HMAC sharing parameters.

methods.name: ComputeSharedHmac
methods.description: Computes a shared HMAC based on a set of HMAC sharing parameters.

methods.name: VerifyAuthorization
methods.description: Verifies an authorization request and generates a response with a HMAC.

methods.name: GenerateTimestampToken
methods.description: Creates a timestamp token with an HMAC signature.

methods.name: ComputeHmac
methods.description: Computes an HMAC over provided data using gatekeeper's key.

methods.name: CreateKeyId
methods.description: Creates a key identifier by HMAC signing the key material.
